bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. All bags are searched, and bags that are not clear get additional screening.
prohibited: Large bags and backpacks (must go to Coat Check)
Professional cameras or detachable lenses without a media pass
Weapons, including pepper spray and knives
Laser pointers, glow sticks, LED gloves
bagPolicy.note: Large bags and backpacks must be checked at Coat Check. Medication must be in its original container with a name matching your photo ID; the venue cannot store medication.

parking.note: Irving Plaza does not directly manage any parking facilities in the vicinity. Visitors are encouraged to use public transportation options available nearby.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Irving Plaza's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Irving Plaza offers a selection of beers from local breweries and national brands, along with handcrafted cocktails available at every bar. The Jocco's Ransom VIP Lounge provides an exclusive beverage menu in a comfortable atmosphere.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Irving Plaza, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Irving Plaza's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Irving Plaza. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Irving Plaza. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
